patch_description:
Replace the rigid CZ line with parametrized CRZ gates that create adaptive entanglement patterns. 
Add RX rotations for better basis mixing. Replace one final RZ layer with RX to introduce rotation 
diversity. This structure maintains similar parameter count (~18-20 per block) while enabling:

1. Parametrized two-qubit gates (CRZ) that can learn optimal entanglement strength
2. Better single-qubit expressivity through RX-RY-RZ triple rotation on key qubits
3. Cross-qubit interactions that adapt during training

The key insight is that parametrized controlled rotations allow the circuit to learn 
whether to entangle strongly or weakly, rather than applying fixed CZ gates uniformly.
